text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've washed our hands,<n>we can go to
offer our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I get in line with Grass Wonder, and<n>before long,
our turn arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Now, what to pray for?
choice_data_list: Pray that Grass sharpens her running form.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Being mindful of my condition? How<n>kind of you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Just knowing that you care has<n>brightened
my spirits.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
With this new boost, perhaps I'll start<n>pushing
myself extra hard... Just<n>kidding.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Stronger, you say? You must be<n>expecting big
things from me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm already on my way to becoming<n>a "Beast." If I
get even stronger, I<n>might gobble you up! Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sharper running, is it? Interesting.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's true, I'm now entering my senior<n>year. I'll be
up against all the best<n>racers from here on.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So we must hone my skills to a<n>razor's edge. I'll
be counting on you,<n>Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now that we have made our prayers...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We should be heading back to the<n>academy for
training. But since it's a<n>holiday, why don't we take
our time?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It would be a waste not to fully take in<n>the
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's be off, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two of us take a stroll through the<n>grounds of
the shrine, replete with the<n>festive mood of New
Year's.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Except... For some reason, Grass<n>Wonder seems
strangely distracted<n>the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I believe I fell into a New<n>Year's daze.
Hehe, how careless of<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... why don't we begin with<n>the usual warm
up?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: That's when she appears.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A gust of wind! Her signature red!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The swift Phantom Bird has landed on<n>the field of
battle!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's the world's strongest racer! El<n>Condor Pasa, in
the hooouse!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What are you doing here?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Behind her calm smile burns the spirit<n>of a warrior.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In the eye of the flamin' whirlwind,<n>the turf is set
aflame! The world is<n>shaken by a deep blue of
unknown!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder! To the ring!
Is this... another challenge?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Listen, El, I already have plans for<n>today...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh. Ya scared, huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Think you're gonna relive that shame<n>ya felt at the
Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I saw the whole thing, Grass. Your<n>contienda
against Sei.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And it bored me till I was pullin' at my<n>hair!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My corazón and alma were left utterly<n>unmoved!
Your race was so lacking in<n>heat, I almost caught a
cold!
You don't...
You don't understand a thing, El.

To be refused the opportunity to even<n>compete!
Denied the chance to claim<n>the "Beast" name!
Look at me, Grass!

I am the Phantom Bird, rápida like<n>lightning, the
strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: The barrera gigante that blocks your<n>path to the top!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A wall you must clear at all costs if<n>you want to
reach your true<n>destination!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Just like Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh...

Bein' refused the "Beast" title? What<n>kinda
nonsense is that?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Your objective—the prize you had<n>your eye on this
whole time...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was it nothin' more than a name?
...Forget it. You're not invited to the<n>ring.

If I face ya when you're like this... it'll<n>just kill the
fire inside me, too.
Adiós.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After El Condor Pasa leaves, Grass<n>Wonder stands
unmoving, as if<n>frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no approaching her like this.<n>The air
practically crackles around her<n>as she stands there
in silence, until...
As if shot out from a cannon, she<n>dashes up to me.

Trainer. Do you still have the paper<n>where I wrote
to you my promise?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her voice is soft, but it's impossible<n>to miss the
flames blazing just<n>beneath the surface. If she
means the<n>calligraphy paper with "determination"
written on it, then...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Would you please hand it to me?<n>Right now.

Chills run down my spine. I pull out<n>the paper as
fast as I can.

Snatching it out of my grasp, Grass<n>Wonder holds
up the beautifully<n>written kanji and—

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She shreds it in two.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Determination... What a joke.

I was a coward, too timid to keep<n>walking along the
path.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's shadow loomed too<n>tall, too grand...
and swallowed me<n>whole.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I became trapped by the name<n>"Beast."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If I truly reach the pinnacle at the end<n>of this path,
titles will come naturally.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I won't hesitate anymore.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's a new year, Trainer, so allow me<n>to renew my
promise.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder takes out a brush.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Determination.

No matter what walls stand in my<n>way, I will not
flinch before them!
Never again, until the day I reach the<n>top!

Trainer, I want to try running in the<n>Takarazuka
Kinen as my next race<n>goal. Would that be
acceptable?

As with the Arima, entry is<n>determined by public
vote. What<n>better stage to demonstrate my<n>renewed
determination?
When I reach the top, everyone will<n>be watching!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes!
I apologize for having worried you.
